title: Globally, More People Expect AI to Cause Job Loss Than Growth
summary_en: Amid a mix of concern and excitement about AI, a 37-country survey finds pessimism about its potential impact on jobs and economic inequality.
title_cn: Globally, More People Expect AI to Cause Job Loss Than Growth

title: Democrats are now more worried than Republicans about AI and its impact on jobs
summary_en: In another shift, Democrats are now more likely than Republicans to predict that AI will lead to fewer jobs over the next 20 years (75% vs. 68%).
title_cn: Democrats are now more worried than Republicans about AI and its impact on jobs

title: Weighting Polls on Party Affiliation and Past Vote
summary_en: This report explains how political weighting works, how Pew Research Center does it, and some of its limitations.
title_cn: Weighting Polls on Party Affiliation and Past Vote

title: 2026 primary season yields greatest preelection House turnover in over 3 decades
summary_en: 74 House members won’t return next Congress – more than before any general election since 1992.
